name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
label: Quest
description: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The forging of a powerful breastplate to protect against the unrelenting attacks of the chromatic flight is one built upon irony.
The scales of the very beasts we battle must be sewn to the pristine carapace of an elder chromatic drake or dragon. None are known to exist at this time and we should hope that none will ever exist.
Lastly, perhaps the most difficult of all components: the blood of heroes.
The Sculptor must ultimately forge this creation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do you not yet understand? The journey was the destination. Can you not feel the battle scars? The pain you underwent?
Having survived the ordeal, you are a more powerful being. Much more powerful. This breastplate is merely a reflection of your own innate abilities.
